rows.text: returns when qword `0209E5C0` is null; otherwise takes bit 2 of its word `+0x179D2` as a bank index, forms `record + index * 0xBC10`, calls `002B61B0` + 0x34 with `rcx` = that base `+ 0x1B0`, and when the call returns non-zero tail-jumps (`002B61B0` + 0x52) with the same `rcx` and `edx` = 1, returning otherwise

clears bit 1 and sets bit 2 of dword `02B45A00`, then calls `003C5E00` + 0x16 and returns when it is non-zero; otherwise calls `003C5E00` + 0x1F and returns when that is 0, else ORs 2 into dword `02B45A00` and tail-jumps (`003C5E00` + 0x33)

returns when qword `02B47740` is null; otherwise calls `002544B0`, reloads `02B47740` and, when it is non-null, replaces bit 16 of its dword `+0x40` with (the return equals 1), then tail-jumps (`003C9900` + 0x38) with `rcx` = the reloaded qword whether or not it was null

when qword `02B47740` is null tail-jumps (`003C9F80` + 0x41) with no argument set; otherwise calls `002544B0`, reloads `02B47740` and, when it is non-null, replaces bit 15 of its dword `+0x40` with (the return equals 1), then tail-jumps (`003C9F80` + 0x38) with `rcx` = the reloaded qword whether or not it was null

notes: 002544B0 is named by address in 003C9900/003C9F80 because the host excerpt names it ('002544B0()'); every other callee is cited by its site. 003C9900/003C9F80: when the reloaded 02B47740 is null, edx reaches the tail jump unshifted (0 or 1); when it is non-null edx holds the shifted bit; the sentence does not state edx for the tail call. 003C9900 is also entered from 00254AC0 + 0x45 and 00255330 + 0x41. 003C5E00 is also reached by jmp from 00352390 + 0xF and 00352AD0 + 0x12.
